title: •Son Of Skywalker
caption: •Son Of Skywalker (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. Deploys -3 to Dagobah. You must first lose 1 Force to substitute a destiny draw using Jedi Test #5. His training destiny draws are +1. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a card with “training destiny” in its game text. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Luke Skywalker. Son of Anakin. Seeker of Yoda. Levitator of rocks. Ignorer of advice. Incapable of impossible. Reckless is he.

notes: Unique. Yellow pilot-power icon followed by '2.' at the start → {pilot:2} — the wiki stub omits this phrase. The slip prints a long minus (en dash) in 'Deploys –3'; typed as '-3' like the earlier runs. Slip prints the ▼ triangle where the stub expands 'deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; curly double quotes around “training destiny”. Third stat box FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only). Icon column: pilot, warrior. Rebel (Dagobah frame, Rebel disc). Destiny from the printed base card (1; the stub lists 2). Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) not legible at 350 px. Modern: V24-L-sonofskywalker.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 24 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
